t: ff.52 Founding a Nation in your garage
st: Centralisation or decentralisation? An unstable balance

sec.p: Democracy trembles. Democracy and modern institutions are so fragile. The earthquake in Turkey showed that some nation states can't even count people, assess the state of buildings or assign property.

Centralisation or decentralisation? Let's add a piece to today's Futuro Fortissimo: cities. Or rather, centralisation. McKinsey helps us out this time too, pointing out that half of world GDP in the 2010-2020 decade was generated in 3600 regions (covering 1% of the planet).

Homemade nations. Balaji Srinivasan (former CTO of Coinbase and general partner at A16Z) proposes a solution to these problems in his recent book The Network State, freely available online (don't worry, it's also summarised in one sentence, 1000 words, one image, or a short…
